integrity: All stated coefficients and threshold inequalities are reconstructed from exact Gram inverses and symbolically verified, including independently calculated rational small cases. No external certification asserted.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for real continuous degree-one projection on unit metric complete tripartite graphs with exactly two nonsingleton independent classes and no atomic mass; symbolic polynomial positivity is reproducible but not independently audited; Boman (2006) was only accessible as abstract.
title: A four-vertex stability threshold for affine projection on \(K_{m,n,1}\)
